Application Data.NAME: John's Cellular Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Cellular Solutions specializes in the retail sale and repair of cellular phones, offering a wide range of products including new and refurbished devices, accessories, and repair services. Our operations include on-site device repairs, which mainly involve screen replacements and battery installations. We prioritize customer satisfaction and data protection, utilizing secure payment systems to handle sensitive customer information. With a focus on quality, we guarantee our repair services and ensure all products sold are genuine and meet safety standards. Our dedicated staff undergoes regular training to minimize risks associated with repairs and maintain a high standard of service. We also implement loss prevention measures to mitigate the risk of employee dishonesty.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a customer reported damage to their device after a battery replacement service performed on April 10, 2023, due to improper handling. The total cost for the repair and replacement amounted to $1,500.00. The claim is currently pending resolution as we work to rectify the situation and ensure customer satisfaction. Additionally, on June 5, 2023, there was a minor theft of accessories valued at $1,000.00, which has been reported to the authorities, and we have implemented additional security measures to prevent future incidents. Both incidents are being monitored to assess the overall impact on operations.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Burglary-rated safe, Class B, UL Listed, capable of withstanding fire for up to 60 minutes, located in a secure area with access control.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours and alarm system monitoring after hours.
